publication: Wang et al. Nature Cancer 2022, PMID 36539501
verdict_rationale: All three EMT/stemness/mesenchymal signatures trend DOWN at recurrence in the cross-sectional spatial analysis (EMT delta=-0.069, stemness delta=-0.111, mesenchymal delta=-0.127, all p>0.05). Only macrophage markers trend UP (delta=+0.154, p=0.222), consistent with Wang et al. reported peripheral myeloid infiltration. No signature reaches statistical significance. Verdict is SC_NOT_SUPPORTED_YET: the available public data (Visium spatial, 5 unmatched primary vs 5 unmatched recurrent, 1825-gene targeted panel) cannot detect the EMT/mesenchymal shift reported by Wang et al. at single-cell resolution. This is a DATA LIMITATION verdict, not a biological null. The snRNA-seq per-cell analysis (pilot download in progress) is required for a valid SC_ESCAPE verdict.
data_limitation_note: Critical limitation: Visium spatial data provides bulk-like expression per spot (mixed cell types). True sub-cell-type EMT analysis requires RAW.tar (1.5 GB) per-cell count matrices for macrophage/T-cell/tumor cell-specific scoring. The 1825-gene targeted panel also lacks VIM, MMP2, NES, ALDH1A1, OLIG2, CHI3L1, SERPINE1 — key EMT/stemness markers. Cross-sectional design (5 unmatched primary vs 5 unmatched recurrent patients) has n=5 per group — insufficient power for Mann-Whitney U. Wang et al. paper reports EMT/mesenchymal shift at single-cell resolution in the full dataset; this analysis cannot replicate that with public spatial data.

what_wang_et_al_actually_found.primary_finding: Proneural-to-mesenchymal shift at recurrence driven by peripheral monocyte-derived macrophage infiltration
what_wang_et_al_actually_found.tumor_cell_finding: Mesenchymal tumor cell fraction increases within tumor compartment at recurrence
what_wang_et_al_actually_found.immune_finding: T-cell expansion at recurrence (outlier cases 2-8x above mean)
what_wang_et_al_actually_found.resolution_used: Single-nucleus RNA-seq per cell, not bulk spatial

audit_note: VERIFICATION CORRECTION 2026-05-13: Prior SC_MIXED_SIGNAL verdict was incorrect. The verdict_rationale claimed 'all three signatures trend upward' but the stored per_signature_results show DOWN direction for all three EMT/stemness/mesenchymal scores. The reconciliation was based on an unvalidated background agent result that hit iteration limit before writing files. Verdict corrected to SC_NOT_SUPPORTED_YET. SC_MIXED_SIGNAL or SC_ESCAPE_SUPPORTED can only be assigned after snRNA-seq per-cell analysis.
verdict_label_note: SC_NOT_SUPPORTED_YET is the correct label for the Visium spatial lane. The spatial assay is structurally incapable of resolving per-cell EMT state (mixed-cell spots, 1825-gene targeted panel, cross-sectional n=5). SC_UNDERPOWERED applies to the snRNA-seq lane (n=8 matched pairs, Wilcoxon p>0.05 due to inter-patient heterogeneity, not assay incapability). These are distinct failure modes and must not be conflated.

sc_mixed_signal_divergence_record.divergence_cause: Agent 3884c4ac reported "all three signatures trend upward" in its summary text, but the per_signature_results it stored showed DOWN direction for all three (EMT delta=-0.069, stemness delta=-0.111, mesenchymal delta=-0.127). The agent hit its iteration limit and its summary text was written from an intermediate state that contradicted the final stored numbers. SC_MIXED_SIGNAL requires at least one signature UP and one DOWN with directional consistency — the stored data shows all three DOWN, which does not meet that criterion. A subsequent reconciliation note accepted the agent summary without checking the stored numbers — this was the second error. Correction: SC_NOT_SUPPORTED_YET (data limitation, not mixed signal).
sc_mixed_signal_divergence_record.correction_rationale: All three EMT/stemness/mesenchymal signatures are DOWN in the stored data. Macrophage is UP (+0.154). This is a single-direction finding, not mixed. The correct verdict is SC_NOT_SUPPORTED_YET because the assay (Visium spatial, bulk-like spots, targeted panel) cannot resolve per-cell EMT state regardless of direction.

visium_mixed_cell_limitation.limitation: Visium spatial transcriptomics captures expression from tissue spots (~55 µm diameter, ~1-10 cells per spot). Each spot is a mixture of tumor cells, immune cells, endothelial cells, and stroma. EMT/mesenchymal scores computed from spot-level expression are therefore a weighted average across all cell types present in the spot, not a tumor-cell-specific or macrophage-specific measurement.
visium_mixed_cell_limitation.consequence_for_emt_scoring: A spot with high macrophage infiltration will show elevated CD44, VIM, TGFB1 (mesenchymal markers) from macrophages, not from tumor cells. This confounds tumor-cell EMT scoring with immune infiltration. Wang et al. specifically reported that the mesenchymal shift at recurrence is driven by macrophage infiltration — meaning the Visium assay cannot distinguish the two signals.
visium_mixed_cell_limitation.consequence_for_verdict: Even if the Visium data showed mesenchymal UP at recurrence, it would be uninterpretable as tumor-cell EMT escape without cell-type deconvolution. The snRNA-seq per-cell analysis is the only valid assay for SC_ESCAPE verdict.
